sources.note: Last 42 days. Magic Online: 79 tournaments, 910 lists from Challenges and other events, 197 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder.
